_note: Spell visuals config (hand-maintained, engine-neutral). wandTip: offset from the hero sprite's bottom-centre in fractions of the hero's on-screen width/height (x 0.5 = right edge, y -0.6 = 40% of the height from the top). Recipes: Arty's public/spells/spells_fx.json (1280x720 frame, schema in art/spells/README.md); every cast runs for the recipe's own length (1.5-2.9 s; super_blizzard ~4.2 s, meteor_shower ~4.0 s), capped at castAnim.maxMs, and a tap / Enter / Space skips it. elementFallback: the recipe used for a spell that has no recipe of its own. statusCanvas: fx/manifest.json status offsets are 960x540 px (x 1280/960). flash: at most one camera flash per cast, white, under maxMs (only lightning has one).
